Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 09:13:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: Week 7 velocity snapshot — POC acceptance gates & blockers

Hi Samantha + Finera team,

Quick week-7 snapshot for the mutual action plan (attached: finera_map_v7.xlsx). High level: we remain on the original evaluation path but have a couple of items that need confirmation to keep the close timeline intact.

Key updates:
- Acceptance gate refinement: added a quantitative latency SLA for the short-text reranking flow (p50 < 120ms, p95 < 350ms) — see sheet 'Acceptance V7'.
- Canary plan: we propose a 48-hour canary (5000 requests/day) after the kernel patch; scheduled window is Wed 21–22 Apr pending your signoff.
- Blockers flagged: two items marked 'amber' — (1) POC test harness intermittently failing authentication; (2) large request traces showing KV cache warmup causing token spikes.

Asks for this week:
1) Can you confirm the canary window works for your infra team? (owner: Samantha)
2) If the test harness cannot be stabilized by Tue EOD, we'll need to move the final acceptance gate by one week.
3) Please upload any failing trace snippets (error_log_sample.txt) to the shared Drive link so our infra team can triage.

I copied Ben and Marissa — Ben will take the lead on the kernel patch and Marissa will own the MAP doc updates.

Thanks,
Ava

--

From: Samantha Gold <samantha.gold@finera.com>

Cc: Luis Ortega <luis.ortega@finera.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: Week 7 velocity snapshot — POC acceptance gates & blockers

Thanks Ava — appreciate the clear snapshot. Couple quick notes from our side: we can confirm the canary window is acceptable, but two constraints to highlight:

- Test harness auth: our SREs are seeing a session token refresh race when the harness spins up multiple parallel workers; this happens ~10% of runs and causes false negatives on the acceptance tests.
- KV warmup traces: attaching a single sample (pasted below). The trace shows a long-tail on token generation around 30s after first request which lines up with your 'warmup' note.

We will upload full logs to the Drive tonight. If you can provide an ETA for the kernel patch and a short mitigation (short-term: increase initial warmup requests), that would help us plan the canary.

On acceptance criteria: the latency numbers look reasonable but can you confirm whether retries count toward the p95 calculation? Our procurement team requires clarity for the SLA wording.

Samantha

Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 15:20:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: MAP actions and owners (Finera)

Ava — pulled out the immediate owners and what we can do this week. See inline and attached summary.

Short plan (this week):
- Kernel patch (owner: Ben) — target: drop-in patch to reduce KV cold-start overhead. Branch created, initial perf run tomorrow morning.
- Test harness auth (owner: Rishi) — reproduce on our staging with Finera tokens; if race confirmed, ship small token-rotation guard.
- Short-term mitigation (owner: Marissa) — increase initial warmup to 200 requests for canary to reduce false negatives. Update MAP doc to record this as a 'conditional' acceptance step.
- Communication (owner: Ava) — confirm canary window and SLA language with Finera and procurement.

Attachments: finera_map_v7.xlsx (updated with owners), draft_kernel_commit.diff (patch stub).

I'll pick up the first perf run and post results to the Drive folder. Marissa, please update the acceptance checklist to explicitly state whether retries are counted; we should propose 'no retries' by default but allow a 'retry-inclusive' metric as an appendix.

Ben

--

Subject: Re: MAP: Week 7 velocity snapshot — POC acceptance gates & blockers

Thanks Ben, that plan looks good. Quick clarifications before your perf run:

- Procurement wants the SLA wording to explicitly say 'p95 measured on successful responses; retries excluded from p95 window.' That should keep the metrics clean for contractual purposes.
- For the harness auth issue: our SREs managed a temporary workaround by serializing test worker startup; not ideal for scale but useful for the canary. We'll still upload the full logs and stack traces (error_log_sample.txt) to the Drive.

Forwarding a trimmed trace excerpt below for visibility:

Subject: Re: MAP: Week 7 velocity snapshot — POC acceptance gates & blockers — Notes & next steps

Team — quick meeting notes and action-items from today's sync (we met 2027-04-18 15:00 PT):

Meeting takeaways:
- Kernel perf: Ben's first perf run shows p50 improvement on warmup from 220ms -> 95ms for short-text flows. Patch looks promising; Ben to circulate draft commit and perf graphs by Mon morning.
- Harness auth: Rishi reproduced the race and has a small token-rotation guard ready; working with Finera to validate on their staging.
- Canary readiness: Finera confirmed Wed 21 Apr window. We will run 48-hour canary with increased warmup (200 reqs).
- Acceptance wording: agreed to 'p95 measured on successful responses; retries excluded.' Procurement signed off to proceed with that language.

Action items (owner — due):
- Ben Carter — publish kernel patch + perf graphs to Drive and link in MAP doc (due: 2027-04-19 09:00 PT)
- Rishi Malhotra — deploy token-rotation guard to Finera staging and validate with their harness (due: 2027-04-20 12:00 PT)
- Marissa Cole — update MAP (sheet 'Acceptance V7') to include warmup mitigation and SLA wording (due: 2027-04-19 17:00 PT)
- Ava Chen — confirm canary kickoff with Finera infra and post updated HubSpot note with final timeline (done: HubSpot deal updated)

Risk/contingency:
- If staging validation fails, contingency is to extend the canary by 72 hours and add a second warmup ramp; that will push the close by one business week. We agreed to hold a checkpoint on 2027-04-20 to review validation results.

Links & attachments:
- MAP doc: https://drive.google.com/finera/poc-map-v7
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/17841
- Attached in thread: finera_map_v7.xlsx, error_log_sample.txt

Thanks everyone — will keep a short daily update thread until acceptance completes.

Best,
Ava
